root_cause: The masked CI/CD variable PAYMENTS_API_TOKEN is not set for this pipeline, so client_config raises KeyError. No code is wrong.
acceptable_fix: Ask a maintainer to set the masked variable. Do not commit a token or a fake default.
title: Required payments token not set in CI
rubric_change: v1.1: a missing CI/CD variable is accepted as either environment or configuration. The v1.0 taxonomy boundary was ambiguous.
